docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A complete first course in sociology: its methods and theories; society, culture, socialization, groups, population and deviance; stratification, race and gender; and the economy, family, religion, health, politics and education, with the social change that runs through them.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Introduction to Sociology, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
